items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I spoke to Steve Brown, who made some of those sessions.

ctx.x: Can you think, did he ever tell you anything or you of course have done more work probably on research in the New Orleans Rhythm Kings than anyone I know, any details about those sessions that isn't, a lot of that's been written up. Anything that isn't widely known about those sessions? I mean, they were all in Richmond, Indiana, I guess, weren't they? Yeah, that's right. They went over there. Anything about the trips over there that you can remember?

Well, it's a funny thing, Bill, about those things. I spoke to Steve Brown, who made some of those sessions. I talked with Mel Stetzel, who made a lot of them, Georgie Brunas. None of them remember anything vivid. Well, you don't get much detail. No, you can't get details. In fact, Georgie Brunas can't tell you who was on the session. Believe it or not, he can't. If you said, Georgie, who was on this particular tune and so forth, he saw this guy and that guy and he's got them all wrong. Sometimes the piano player…
And it really gets mixed up. I just thought maybe you might remember certain things that maybe you heard from Paul or other people that you've talked to about these sessions that isn't widely known.
